summary: New installs use standard names, and private installs behind a firewall reply to your network correctly.

new.title: Standard names for new installs
new.text: New installs use standard Azure names and fewer identities. Existing installs keep every name they have, and the setup tools still find them.

new.title: Private installs work behind a firewall
new.text: A private install behind a central firewall can now route replies back to your network. Without this, connections from your network would time out.
